notes: Encodes cleanly as a passive magic item with set_ability_score (int, 19, floor). The SRD 'no effect if Intelligence is 19 or higher without it' is exactly the floor semantics already in the surface. No wearing_item predicate was needed since the attunement gate implicitly scopes the passive to the wearer. Identical shape to Amulet of Health and Gauntlets of Ogre Power.
